meaning:
εὔσημος, -ον
(εὖ + οῆμα, a sign) [in LXX for כֶּסֶא, Psa.81:3 (-ως, from LXX 219)* ;]
1. conspicuous (cf. Ps, l.with).
2. clear to the understanding, distinct: 1Co.14:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
